# run
# echo
# note http.ReadRequest would drop the first body for want of framing, and
# note send only the first two bytes of the second. Rr frames the body itself.
>>> f.rr
-- frames a body with no length --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{"a":1}
-- ignores a stale content-length --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Content-Length: 2

{"b":2}
>>> want f.rr
-- frames a body with no length --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{"a":1}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 7
Content-Type: text/plain

{"a":1}
-- ignores a stale content-length --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Content-Length: 2

{"b":2}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 7
Content-Type: text/plain

{"b":2}
